title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - EUID
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/EUID. European Unique Identifier for businesses in the European Economic Area, Iceland, Liechtenstein, or Norway registered in the Business Registers Interconnection System (BRIS). Subclass of RegistrationNumber per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the RegistrationNumber model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'EUID'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

euid.description: Property. The European Unique Identifier (EUID) for a business located in the European Economic Area, Iceland, Liechtenstein or Norway and registered in BRIS.
